notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome124 impersonation) was blocked on the first request - homepage returned an Akamai Bot Manager interstitial challenge page (bm-verify redirect, /interstitial/ic.html), confirming the known Zara Home Akamai pattern seen on sister sites SR21 UAE and SR90 UK. Escalated immediately to tier (b): Playwright headed Chromium (headless=False) with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, which cleared the block cleanly on first load (title/content rendered correctly, no interstitial). All research done on tier (b); Claude-in-Chrome (tier c) was not needed and was confirmed disconnected per the brief. robots.txt (fetched at domain root, not under /de/) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow and no blanket 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /', so tier (a)/(b) fetches were permitted; the Akamai block is a bot-detection wall, not a robots.txt restriction. TREE: Built the union tree by loading the homepage mega-menu (nav flyout, fully expanded per top-level section) plus each top-level section's own landing page (Schlafzimmer/Bedroom n944, Dekoration n989, Bad/Bathroom n1050, Kueche und Esszimmer/Kitchen&Dining n1012, Kinder/Kids n1094, Moebel/Furniture n4104, Waschkueche/Utility n1835, Schreibwaren/Home Office n1804) to capture each section's own expanded sub-nav flyout. Ambiguous nodes (Koerbe under Dekoration, Matratzen-und-Sitzkissen, Kosmetikeimer, Textilpflege, bad-koerbe-alle vs bad-kosmetik-aufbewahrung vs bad-koerbe-waesche, Kulturbeutel, Schreibwaren-Kollektion, Gitterbettwaesche) were individually opened and their H1/breadcrumb/product content inspected to resolve classification. Every recorded leaf's rendered H1 and breadcrumb was checked against the requested node to rule out silent parent/sibling fallback. QTY: Zara Home displays no explicit product-count total anywhere on category pages (checked static HTML, rendered DOM text, and all JSON network responses for total/count fields - none exist). Per storage.md 36 rule 3 (paginate and count unique product cards - applied analogously for Textile since no site total exists), each leaf was scrolled to full stabilization (mouse-wheel scroll loop until the count of unique product-detail links, matched by URL pattern -l<digits>, stayed constant across 2 consecutive checks) and the resulting unique count recorded as qty with evidence describing the method. EXCLUDED and why: Betten und Kopfteile/Kinder-Moebel/Aufbewahrungsmoebel(n4111)/Regale(n4898) - Furniture (explicitly under Moebel nav, storage.md 21/27 prefer Furniture when explicitly under a Furniture category); Spiegel, Bilderrahmen, Vasen, Wohnzimmer-Kerzen/Kandelaber, Knaeufe und Haken, Handtuchhalter, Seifenspender, Koerperpflege, Zahnputzbecher, Badspiegel, Bad-Beleuchtung - decorative/hardware/fixtures, neither category; Geschirr, Glaeser, Besteck, Servierplatten, Tassen, Untersetzer, Serviettenringe, Kochgeschirr, Kuechengeraete, Muelleimer, Kuehltasche - Kitchen & Dining tableware/hardware, not textile/storage; Bad-Kosmetikeimer(n3827) - sits under Badaccessoires not Aufbewahrung in the site's own hierarchy, functions as a bathroom bin rather than an organizer, excluded as neither (LOW-confidence boundary case, deliberately left out per storage.md 42 rather than forced in); Textilpflege(n1399) - laundry care products/detergents, not textile goods or storage; Kulturbeutel/Kosmetiktaschen(n4748) - site itself files this under Kleidung und Schuhe (Clothing & Shoes), a personal-carrying toiletry bag excluded per storage.md 6; Schreibwaren-Kollektion(n1804) and its Editorial(n5076, dead link/404) - a mixed desks/pens/notebooks/furniture 'Kollektion' landing page with no distinct organizer subcategory, excluded as a Collection page (textile.md 27 / storage.md 35); Kleiderbuegel (hangers, adult and kids) - not an explicit storage/organizer product type per storage.md, excluded; Personalisierung pages (all sections) - personalization services, not product categories; all 'Alles anzeigen' site-wide/section-wide view-all links (sonder-preise, neuheiten, editorials, etc.) - View All/Collections exclusion. gitterbettwaesche(n3948): page title/meta and H1 say 'Kinderbetten und Ruhebettchen' (cribs/bassinets) which reads like Furniture, but the breadcrumb tab is literally 'Gitterbettwaesche' (Crib Bedding) and the actual product grid (verified) is 100% textile bedding (duvet covers, flat sheets, pillowcases, fitted sheets in crib size) - classified Textile based on verified product content, not the misleading title tag.
